# Security vulnerability

Please **do not report security vulnerabilities through a public GitHub issue**.

If you believe you have identified a security vulnerability affecting this project or [sammcnab.co.uk](https://sammcnab.co.uk), please review the repository's [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) and report it privately via:

**https://sammcnab.co.uk/contact**

Do not include vulnerability details, credentials, personal information, access tokens, screenshots containing sensitive information, or instructions for exploiting the issue in a public issue.

If your report is a normal bug and does not involve a security vulnerability, please use the standard bug report template instead.
